about: LFM3-1.7B (MLX · 8-bit, Liquid AI's own export) on mlx-vlm 0.7.12's server with a 131,072-token window, one request at a time, thinking on by default. The same packages, weights, launcher and command as mlx-vlm-lfm3-1.7b-8bit-256k; only the declared window is smaller, for an 8 GB Mac: the full 262,144 window peaked at 6.73 GiB of GPU memory on the M1 Max, more than macOS lets the GPU wire on 8 GB. Prefill runs in 128-token steps and MLX_VLM_TOKEN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT is raised, for the reasons the 256K launch gives. About 2 GB of weights.
install: python3 -m pip install mlx-vlm==0.7.12 mlx==0.32.4 transformers==5.22.2 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10)
